# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within KerkenezSpeech, please do not disclose it publicly via issue trackers. Instead, report it directly to the maintainers or open a private security advisory on GitHub.

We take security seriously and will acknowledge receipt of your report within 48 hours and provide a timeline for a resolution.
